title: Codex Adjudication Result
description: Schema for Codex's final adjudication when fact review Stage B finds unresolvable conflicts.

adjudication_id.description: Unique identifier for this adjudication record.

issue_ref.description: Reference to the issue from the Stage B review.

decision.description: accepted: Stage B finding accepted, Codex will revise. rebutted: Codex overrules, keeping original. unconfirmed: neither side conclusive, mark as 【推断】.

rationale.description: Codex's reasoning for the decision, citing evidence.

action.description: Specific action to take (e.g., revise claim X, add 【推断】 after sentence Y).

affects_knowledge_base.description: Whether this decision requires a knowledge base update.

knowledge_base_entries.description: Knowledge base entry IDs that need updating.

notes.description: Additional notes about the adjudication process or patterns observed.
